    20→        where: { shop, eventType: "view", sizeChartId: { not: null } },
    21→        _count: { id: true },

- Computes 4 funnel rates: click rate, recommend rate, convert rate, and overall end-to-end rate

**Component:**
- `<s-button-group>` preset selector (7d / 30d / 90d) in the page primary-action slot — reloads via `fetcher.load`
- 4 stat overview cards with `.toLocaleString()` formatting and loading skeleton (`—`)

- `FunnelBar` progress bars with color-coded rates and benchmark badges (green when above threshold)
- `RankBadge` gold/silver/bronze circles for top 5 charts
- Plan-gated upgrade wall (Growth plan required) with teaser cards showing locked features
- Pro upsell banner for return attribution when on Growth plan
- Insights sidebar with dynamic tips (fires when click rate < 10% or recommend rate < 20%)
- Empty state when no data exists for the selected period

### `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`

**Loader:** Fetches current subscription and returns `billingInterval` so the toggle initializes correctly.

- "Why Merchants Switch to Us" with 3 competitive differentiator cards (flat pricing, mobile-first, 5-min setup)
